activities.name: Tempoross
activities.rateNote: Rates are per reward permit used at the reward pool. Duplicate-protected rewards are still evaluated at their original first-copy rate.

activities.name: Wintertodt
activities.rateNote: Wintertodt awards a variable number of reward rolls based on points. Enter reward rolls, not games. The cart checks uniques sequentially, so the catalog uses their effective mutually exclusive rates. Pyromancer pieces are omitted because their selection changes with ownership.

activities.name: Zulrah
activities.rateNote: Each kill has two main loot rolls. The three fangs/visage and both mutagens are represented per roll; jar and pet are independent per kill. Uncut onyx is omitted because it is not exclusive to Zulrah.

activities.name: Vorkath
activities.rateNote: The tracked rare drops roll independently. Vorkath's head is omitted because its guaranteed 50th-kill protection does not have a fixed independent rate.

activities.name: Barrows
activities.rateNote: Assumes all six brothers are killed before every chest: seven reward rolls, each with a 1/102 equipment chance, then an equal choice among 24 pieces. Runs with fewer brothers are not represented.
